about: Wish list export (spec 6.7.1, Premium). CSV is for spreadsheets and shopping; text is for pasting into Messages or Discord, where an attachment cannot be read in the thread. Both implementations must produce these bytes exactly.

cases.name: csv quotes a name containing a comma and a quote
text names the set once and flags a copy held elsewhere
cases.expected:
Obsidian Flames — need 2:
  Charmander 003/197
  Fletchling, "rare" 007/197  [have a copy elsewhere]

cases.name: an empty list says so rather than producing a bare header
